## Checklist

Rules are in `AGENTS.md`; how to run the checks is in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

- [ ] Contracts first: a new behaviour is in `docs/contracts/`, a changed boundary has an ADR in `docs/adr/`.
- [ ] Wire values, limits, error codes and design tokens come from `contracts/`; I used the generated forms and typed no method, event or error-code name by hand.
- [ ] Generated outputs are committed with their source (`uv run python contracts/generate.py`, and `--check` is clean). I edited no generated file by hand.
- [ ] One rule, one place: I searched for an existing helper, constant or policy before adding one. No dead code, no new file over 800 lines.
- [ ] `uv run python scripts/check_quality.py` passes. Baselines that improved are lowered in this PR; any raised baseline has its reason in `scripts/quality_baseline_justifications.json`.
- [ ] No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in engine or desktop production code, no new swallowed errors, no blocking IO under the Core lock.
- [ ] `bash scripts/check_all.sh --tier fast` passes (outside contributors: with `SOYEHT_SKIP_FORBIDDEN_TERMS=1`; a maintainer runs the vocabulary scan).
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and no test, acceptance or gate step was removed. If one was, a `Verification change:` line below says why.
- [ ] English everywhere; no secrets, tokens, team IDs, VM addresses or machine-specific values; nothing from `benchmark/`.
- [ ] Commit messages, this title and this body carry no AI attribution (no co-author trailers, no "generated by" lines).
